baseline_models.mechanism: The settlement lexeme joins a gathered people to the specific practice of feeding a guest; the food request activates that practice, and the inhabitants collectively refuse it.

activation_trace.role: A village is literally a gathering of people, supplying the collective body that acts.
Feeding a guest from gathered food is a village-root image, making hospitality an internal function of the named settlement.
Requesting that another provide food supplies the explicit demand placed on that communal function.
Severe refusal blocks acceptance of the request and turns omission into an active communal stance.
A traveler descending upon others as a guest specifies the relation the inhabitants decline.

changed_reading.before: Two travelers encounter an inhospitable town.
changed_reading.after: A gathered settlement refuses a guest-feeding function already latent in its own designation, so its social coherence fails at the point of hospitality.

baseline_models.mechanism: The sequence moves from an unbound construction to uprightness, valuation, and compensation. Since أجر also images mending a crooked fracture, the repair has already materialized one kind of ajr before Musa proposes taking another.

activation_trace.role: Undoing a bound or built structure supplies the wall's imminent structural failure.
Straightness and equilibrium supply the physical result of setting the wall right.
Valuation and pricing turn the same restoration into work that can be appraised.
Acquiring something for oneself supplies Musa's proposed conversion of the deed into income.
Payment for work supplies the ordinary economic reading of the proposed wage.
Mending a fracture that healed crookedly folds the wall's rectification back into the wage lexeme.

changed_reading.before: Khidr repairs a wall gratuitously, and Musa suggests charging for the work.
changed_reading.after: The repair and the proposed wage mirror one another: the wall is straightened, valued, and already given the fracture-mending image carried by ajr, while monetary ajr remains untaken.

baseline_models.mechanism: The wall's attributed desire can be read as compressed material diagnosis: oscillation and load-strain announce failure, while iqama answers with support, preservation, and restored standing.

activation_trace.role: The elevated wall supplies the built body whose standing is at issue.
Back-and-forth movement and failure to settle give the wall's 'wanting' a visible wobble.
Joints or a back creaking under weight give impending collapse an audible strain signal.
Care, preservation, and oversight make setting upright an act of guardianship as well as mechanics.
A supporting mainstay supplies the counterforce that keeps the diagnosed structure standing.

changed_reading.before: The wall's desire is decorative personification meaning that collapse is near.
changed_reading.after: Its 'desire' renders physical instability legible: wobble and strain solicit a preserving support response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus repair becomes the third opaque intervention in a repeated journey sequence. The first two look destructive and the third constructive, yet all three resist judgment from visible effect until their outcomes are disclosed.

activation_trace.role: Preserving care anchors the apparently benevolent third intervention in the focus.
Complete cognitive enclosure supplies the knowledge Musa lacks when judging each intervention.
Knowledge of an affair's interior supplies the hidden layer unavailable at first sight.
A literal breach supplies the first intervention's visibly destructive pole.
Taking life supplies the second and most severe visibly destructive pole.
Return to an eventual outcome supplies the deferred horizon on which all three acts become readable.

structural_cues: 18:71, 18:74, and 18:77 repeat فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰ إِذَا, each followed by an intervention and an objection; 18:78 defers explanation until after the third.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated frame, two destructive surfaces, one constructive surface, and deferred outcomes; I infer one diagnostic series in which visible moral polarity is unreliable. A live alternative is that the repetition marks itinerary without making the three acts functionally symmetric.

changed_reading.before: The wall repair is straightforward kindness after two shocking acts.
changed_reading.after: The repair is the third epistemic test case: even a visibly good act conceals its beneficiary, timing, and governing reason.

context_deltas.mechanism: The wall functions as temporary guardianship: standing masonry keeps stored wealth unavailable while its owners lack a guardian, then yields its contents only after they reach strength. Repair preserves both value and timing.

activation_trace.role: An elevated wall supplies the physical barrier whose continued standing can protect what lies below.
Care and guardianship turn structural repair into surrogate custody.
A mainstay that keeps something standing supplies the material means of that custody.
Children cut off from their guardian supply the vulnerable beneficiaries for whom the wall stands in.
Preserved stored wealth supplies the value held behind the standing barrier.
Arrival at an endpoint supplies the delay's terminating condition.
Attaining mature strength specifies when the owners can replace the wall's guardianship.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies the eventual release of the protected value.
Compassion supplies the governing relation behind preservation without payment.

structural_cues: 18:82 places the treasure under the same wall, assigns it to two orphans, and sequences maturity before extraction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ownership, orphanhood, below-wall treasure, maturity, extraction, and mercy; I infer that continued standing delays access and substitutes for a guardian. The wall may instead be only a cover or site marker, but either alternative still makes repair preserve the release time.

changed_reading.before: Khidr keeps a failing structure upright in the present.
changed_reading.after: He installs a time-bound custodian: the wall stands for absent guardians, holding an inheritance through the owners' vulnerable interval.

context_deltas.mechanism: Musa's proposal and the ship explanation expose two economies of taking: compensation can be acquired for work, whereas a ruler takes working people's property by force. The repair remains deliberately unpriced between them.

activation_trace.role: Acquisition for oneself supplies the legitimate proposed taking attached to repair.
Payment returned for labor supplies the proposed reciprocal exchange.
A worker's wage or livelihood links the ship owners' labor to the focus proposal of earned compensation.
Taking possession supplies the ruler's competing form of acquisition.
Taking by injustice and force marks that competing acquisition as coercive rather than earned.

structural_cues: The proposed taking of a wage at 18:77 is followed in the explanation by a king who takes every ship forcibly from poor workers at 18:79.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies work, wage, two instances of taking, and coercion; I infer an ethical contrast between earned acquisition and seizure, with the untaken wage keeping the repair outside both. Alternatively, Musa may be proposing only a pragmatic way to recover food, without a broader theory of exchange.

changed_reading.before: Musa sensibly proposes payment for useful labor.
changed_reading.after: His proposal names the legitimate counterpart to predatory taking, while the actual repair declines appropriation and remains a protected transfer to unseen owners.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pair first finds a servant carrying granted mercy and knowledge, then finds a wall whose concealed yield is later extracted as stored wealth and mercy. Repeated finding shifts the wall from incidental obstacle to an encountered carrier of hidden benefit.

activation_trace.role: Coming upon the servant supplies the first discovery in the paired finding sequence.
Granted compassion supplies a hidden benefit carried by the first discovered figure.
Knowledge disclosed to a knower supplies the unseen capacity of that figure.
Coming upon the wall repeats finding but transfers the discovered object from person to structure.
Preserved hidden wealth supplies the wall's initially invisible yield.
Extraction from concealment supplies the later disclosure of what the found wall carried.

structural_cues: The same dual subject finds the servant at 18:65 and the wall at 18:77; 18:82 discloses what was hidden under the wall.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated finding, mercy and knowledge in the first encounter, and concealed wealth in the second; I infer a parallel between encountered carriers of unseen benefit. A live alternative is that وجد merely advances the itinerary and does not couple the two finds.

changed_reading.before: The pair happens upon a failing wall.
changed_reading.after: They find a second opaque carrier: the wall's visible defect masks a stored benefit just as the earlier found servant's visible presence masked granted knowledge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers a hospitality image to masonry. It remains anchored by the focus inventory's literal leaning sense for ضيف, the wall's imminent fall, and iqama as support; downstream prose should present it only as a social-material analogy, not as literal identification or causal equivalence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فَأَبَوْا أَن يُضَيِّفُوهُمَا ... جِدَارًا يُرِيدُ أَن يَنقَضَّ فَأَقَامَهُ

activation_trace.role: A thing leaning onto another supplies the material analogue latent in refused guesting.
The elevated wall supplies the second body now unable to maintain itself.
A built structure coming undone supplies the wall's need to lean on support.
A mainstay that prevents falling supplies Khidr's reception of that structural dependence.

changed_reading.before: The refusal of guests and the repair of a wall are adjacent but unrelated events.
changed_reading.after: The people refuse the travelers who lean upon them, while Khidr receives the leaning wall by becoming its support.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because focus أَبَوْا ordinarily realizes refusal, while parental care comes from the packet's non-dominant ء ب و mapping. It remains valid as an explicitly supplied split-root activation sharpened by the father and orphans in 18:82; downstream prose must label it exploratory resonance, not derive fatherhood from the focus form.

activation_trace.role: Fatherhood as causative nurture supplies a non-dominant counterimage inside the focus refusal inventory.
Preserving care supplies the focus action through which that counterimage becomes functional.
Actual fatherhood and nurture in the explanation stabilize the packet-supplied parental branch.
Loss of a child's guardian supplies the gap through which the father's care must persist indirectly.
The father's soundness supplies the enduring moral cause attached to the children's protection.
Nurturing, repairing, and bringing to completion supplies the agency that carries parental care across absence.

changed_reading.before: Communal refusal is followed by an unexplained act of wall repair.
changed_reading.after: An exploratory split-root echo opposes failed present nurture by the town to an absent father's care, prolonged through repair until his children can receive it.

strongest_changes: The village's own branch field includes guest-feeding, so the refusal reads as failure of a constitutive communal function.
Ajr joins payment to mending a crooked fracture, making the repaired wall a material counterpart to the wage that is proposed but not taken.
The later disclosure turns upright masonry into time-bound guardianship over an inheritance and places legitimate wage-taking against coercive seizure.
summary.what_was_special: The focus lexicon cross-connects social, material, and economic mechanisms: قري gathers people and feeds guests, ضيف leans, قوم stands, guards, and values, and أجر pays while mending a crooked break. Context converts those links into deferred custody without collapsing their distinct readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The parental activation depends on the packet's non-dominant ء ب و mapping for focus ء ب ي and must remain exploratory.
The guest-wall parallel is analogical; the grammar does not identify the wall as a guest.
The wall may be cover, marker, or container; the packet supports temporal protection more strongly than any single physical mechanism.
